test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'POT' is coded as '15-14-19' and 'SPLIT' is coded as '18-15-11-8-19'. What is the code for 'PERFORM' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 'POT' is coded as '15-14-19'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b3e03d1d0a9cb1fbe146458524529a8988c60dec98708977bf2d4f5fe024b40.png] 

And,

'SPLIT' is coded as '18-15-11-8-19'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89e2ebcb724d24b709e766bc6bbf3ac136b4c820ee53b9a0d4737182fa70d926.png] 

Similarly,

'PERFORM' is coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccf5b5d04b0c4583ed881beb323deb52998193cae5d896635944c24aa9705dfe.png] 

Thus, 'PERFORM' is coded as 15-4-17-5-14-17-12

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
